training.encoded_loss: Existing activity/quiet- and replica-balanced mean squared normalized asinh(gas/0.01) residual /3. Full frozen-trajectory endpoints, no overlapping rollout windows because base features are fixed.
training.peak_aware_extra: Add0.25 times squared relative full-trajectory peak-amplitude error, plus0.1 times mean squared physical gas error over endpoint times<=32.2s, normalized per history by full true gas peak floored at0.01kg/s. Both penalties are symmetric in under/overprediction. Average histories inversely to TRAIN replica count.
training.optimizer_state: Each arm starts with fresh independent AdamW state; initial optimizer is empty because this head is new. Replay must verify one real next update after nonempty-state checkpoint/restore on CUDA before training proceeds. Save optimizer/RNG/batch cursor/history/best at epoch and deadline boundaries.
training.selection: Baseline epoch0 and every tenth epoch eligible. Require original objective and every state MAE<=105%baseline, quiet increase<=0.001physical encoding scale, integral/timing/consistency<=105%baseline, overprediction p90<=105%baseline, finite, and peak-amplitude MAE<=baseline. Among eligible checkpoints choose minimum startup gas p90 normalized deficit, break ties by original objective then earlier epoch. Select each arm independently and freeze before comparison. Primary remains peak_aware versus unchanged GRU; no test evaluation.

definitions.startup: Existing endpoint<=32.2s max positive gas deficit per history normalized by full true gas peak, zero denominators reported, configuration-balanced replica averages then p90. Exact existing diagnostic must be reused.
definitions.gas_dry_fuel_consistency: Configuration-balanced absolute difference between trapezoidal signed gas integral/0.75 and predicted initial-minus-final unreacted dry-fuel mass. A consistency guard for derived measures, not conservation-law validation.
definitions.quiet: Reuse the exact preexisting quiet-state diagnostic, not a new mask chosen from candidate outcomes.
definitions.additional_reporting: Report gas overprediction tails, minimum/negative magnitudes and fractions, mass increases, selected epoch, all comparisons, and bound saturation; do not hide failures.

budget_plan.expected_cost: Prior two-arm head trial used192.66s task time and0.071USD estimated compute including VM startup. Shape normalization adds work; no guarantee extrapolating timing. Same0.40allowance and deadline bounds, checkpoint and stop if slow.
budget_plan.other_reservations: Preserve the separate Flex queue and all other allowances. Reconcile live budget and inventory before upload or launch; prepared plan is not authorization to bypass those checks.

scope: Prospective development-only shape calibration comparison on previously examined grouped rotation0 validation; not pristine confirmation or a repair of all four state dynamics. No test features/evaluation, new fitting or launch at preparation. Prior failed trials remain failed. Physical setup and output meanings remain those documented in candidate-plan.json.
architecture: Same769parameter head and initial weights, half-log factor span sqrt(0.5)..sqrt(2), normalized by base-forecast trapezoidal weighted means separately for positive/negative rates. Final factors0.5..2, each signed-part integral preserved within float tolerance. Other states, base GRU and base total-release error remain unchanged. Full generated forecast is needed, not future truth or an online one-step correction.
selection_change_provenance: Prospective new trial after gas-head01 near miss, not a reclassification or reselection of its failed primary. Original acceptance thresholds unchanged; add overprediction-tail guard. New checkpoint selection directly targets the startup deficit subject to the allowed original-objective/state safeguards instead of requiring global-objective argmin.
